reason: The plugin is primarily a user-interface navigation/interaction enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web that targets question and plan panels, adding a collapse/expand control to reduce occupied space while retaining draft input. Evidence from the repository metadata, package manifest, and README consistently describes only front-end panel behavior and local UI state handling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的提问/审批面板增强插件，可在面板标题区提供折叠入口，让面板在紧凑条与完整输入模式间切换并保留当前未提交草稿。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web question/approval panel helper that adds a collapse control in the panel header to switch between compact strip mode and full view while keeping the current unsent draft.

capabilities: Adds a chevron control in DSH question/approval panel headers for collapse/expand.
Collapses the panel UI to a compact strip and restores full panel content on demand.
Preserves unsent draft input while collapsed by keeping panel state active.
Stores collapsed state in localStorage for persistence across refresh/workspace changes.
Targets both QuestionFlow and PlanReviewPanel panel shapes in DSH Web.

reasons.code: Repository description and README state the plugin collapses the DSH question panel into a compact strip and restores it, preserving unsent draft text.
README specifies implementation via class toggling and hiding `[data-question-scroll]` content area/footer while keeping component state alive.
README documents persistence behavior: collapsed state is saved to localStorage and retained after refresh/workspace switching.
manifest-like package settings indicate a web client plugin using DSH client platform with no server-side entry dependencies.
